meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为你的产品撰写或优化营销文案:它先询问产品名称、功能、受众、卖点等信息,再分析受众、提炼独特卖点,写出标题、正文(引言/主体/结尾)和行动号召,并加入情感词汇、数据与客户评价;若给旧文案,它会优化标题、正文和 CTA。
howto.when: 当你说要写产品营销文案、要优化已有文案,或需要为产品生成推广文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我为智能厨电写一篇营销文案,受众是上班族,卖点是智能预约。
say.note: Claude 会先收集信息再按步骤成文。

say.text: 优化这段广告文案的标题和结尾行动号召。
say.note: 它会对标题、正文、CTA 逐项改进。

say.text: 写一篇环保App 的推广文案,加入数据评价和情感词。
say.note: 会引用你给的数据并选用情感词汇。

howto.what_en: Claude writes or optimizes marketing copy for your product. It asks for product info, audience and selling points, then analyzes the audience, crafts a headline, body and CTA, and includes emotional words, data and testimonials. For existing copy, it improves the headline, body and CTA.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for marketing copy for a product, ask to optimize existing copy, or need promotional copy for a product.

say_en.text: Optimize the headline and call-to-action of this ad copy.
say_en.note: It improves headline, body and CTA item by item.

say_en.text: Write promotional copy for an eco-friendly app, adding data and emotional words.
say_en.note: It uses your data and picks emotion words.
